cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

mechanism: A presents its former stall pupil signature as graduation into partnership, using that status to delay explaining the penalty until after commitment.
confusable: Not merely explaining terms to a prospective partner: A conditions the stakes conversation on the very signature B is withholding.
comparison: Visible quiz allegiance versus documented joint-entry commitment.
